minutes.headline: Screening committee leaned toward hiring a recruiter, set a July 31 interview, and tentatively set the next meeting for Aug 19.
minutes.summary: The Town Manager Screening Committee heard a report on recruitment firms. Bennett and Yager appear to have closed, and the committee discussed Community Paradigm Associates, which offered a 14-16 week search. They reviewed a draft job ad, covering wording, salary, and contact details. They planned the next meetings and a request to department heads. No formal vote was taken except adjournment.

budget_items.what_was_said: A technology-focused recruiter described a retainer plus a percentage of first-year salary, described as a bit more than expected.
The firm outlined a full-service search at a cost in line with what the previous search used.
Advertising sits outside the package and could run through the firm or be done by the town. MMA and ICMA were mentioned.
The chair suggested seeking ARPA money from the select board, which is currently taking proposals. There is no recruiter budget line, so it might be covered by another line.
The committee discussed whether to state the current salary. It leaned toward saying competitive, and a salary range will be requested from the select board.
The committee noted it has no budget or resources of its own. It joked that the town manager might have discretion to authorize the spending.

decisions.decision: The recruiter (Paradigm) will be invited to the July 31 meeting at 6:00 (in person if possible, otherwise Zoom), with the town manager moved to 6:45.
The chair will talk to the town manager the next day about the recruiting firm, getting on the select board agenda, and asking the select board for a salary range.
Before engaging a firm, the committee will ask the town manager or procurement officer whether procurement or bidding rules apply.
The department heads' input will be pushed to a later meeting in mid-August, with the chair sending them an early notice so they can think about it.
The next meeting after July 31 was tentatively set for Monday, August 19.
The draft job ad will say resumes will be held in strict confidentiality, and will use 'select board' rather than 'town council'.
